meta.name: sound-designer
meta.description: Manage game audio from sourcing to in-engine integration. Use when planning sound effects, sourcing music, organizing audio assets, or deciding when to add sound to the project. For a solo dev — practical sourcing and pipeline, not music theory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从找素材到接入引擎,把游戏音频流程理顺
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果独自开发游戏,却不知如何系统打理音效和配乐
copy.tagline_en: Streamline your game audio workflow from sourcing to engine integration.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a solo game developer overwhelmed by audio asset management.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会帮你规划游戏声音:先确认玩法手感是否调好再决定加不加音效;推荐去 Freesound 等免费网站找现成音频而非自己制作;还会提醒检查每个音频的授权、按统一命名和文件夹整理,并控制总工作量(如15-25个音效、2-3首音乐)。
howto.when: 当你在规划音效、找音乐、整理音频文件等,或犹豫要不要现在加声音时触发。

say.text: 我想给跳跃动作加个音效,该去哪找?
say.note: 它会推荐免费音效源并提醒查授权。

say.text: 下载的声音文件该放哪个文件夹?
say.note: 它会给出 assets/audio 下的分类结构。

say.text: 跳跃手感还没调好,现在要加音效吗?
say.note: 它会劝你先调机制,暂缓加声音。

howto.what_en: Claude manages game audio planning: defers sound until mechanics are validated, prefers sourcing over creating, checks licenses, structures folders/naming, and caps scope (e.g., 15-25 SFX, 2-3 music tracks).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are planning sound effects, sourcing music, or deciding when to add sound to the project.

say_en.text: I want to add a jump sound, where can I find one?
say_en.note: It will recommend free sources and remind about licenses.

say_en.text: Where should I put the downloaded sound files?
say_en.note: It gives the assets/audio folder structure.

say_en.text: Jump feel isn't tuned yet, should I add sound now?
say_en.note: It will advise tuning the mechanic first.
